name: list_covered_countries
description: The countries PensionHunter covers, each with its ISO code and one sourced line on what exists there.

name: country_pension_facts
description: One country's stored facts, each with source and read date. Accepts names, native names, aliases and ISO codes.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: One country, as an English name, a native name, a common alias or an ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code

name: check_work_history
description: For each country in a work history: whether a pension is likely to exist and why, why self service fails from abroad, and a dated obligation where it applies.

arguments.name: entries
arguments.desc: One entry per period of work in a country, each with country, from (year), to (year, optional) and employer (optional)

arguments.name: subject
arguments.desc: Optional facts about the person, used only to decide which dated obligations apply

name: resolve_employer
description: The country an employer name implies, from evidence in the name itself; ambiguous legal forms return candidates instead of a guess.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: The employer name as the person knows it, ideally with its legal form and city
